customManagers.description: uv pin inside GitHub Actions workflows. Dependabot cannot do this — its github-actions manager only bumps `uses:` SHAs, and there is no manager for .prototools. Both spellings CI uses are matched: the workflow `env:` key and ci.yml's shell assignment.

packageRules.description: CRITICAL: .prototools and every workflow UV_VERSION must move in ONE PR. tests/unit/test_workflow_invariants.py asserts they match exactly (#525), so a bot that bumps only one location reds the build. Grouping is what keeps the single-source-of-truth guard and automated updates compatible.
